statement: Fix a 1-morphism $F:\mathcal X\to\mathcal Y$ of stacks in groupoids on $(\Sch/S)_{fppf}$ and an integer $d\geq1$. Define $\mathcal H_d(\mathcal X/\mathcal Y)$ with objects $(U,Z,y,x,\alpha)$ where $Z\to U$ is finite locally free of degree $d$, $y\in\mathcal Y_U$, $x\in\mathcal X_Z$, and $\alpha:y|_Z\simeq F(x)$. The projection $\mathcal H_d(\mathcal X/\mathcal Y)\to(\Sch/S)_{fppf}$ is a stack in groupoids.

statement: Fix a 1-morphism $F:\mathcal X\to\mathcal Y$ of stacks in groupoids on $(\Sch/S)_{fppf}$ and an integer $d\geq1$. Define $\mathcal H_d(\mathcal X/\mathcal Y)$ with objects $(U,Z,y,x,\alpha)$ where $Z\to U$ is finite locally free of degree $d$, $y\in\mathcal Y_U$, $x\in\mathcal X_Z$, and $\alpha:y|_Z\simeq F(x)$. The forgetful 1-morphism $\mathcal H_d(\mathcal X/\mathcal Y)\to\mathcal H_d(\mathcal X)$ is faithful.
